summary: An operation doubles one current array value or replaces it by its floor-divided-by-two value. For each individual element, all doublings must precede any divisions. Minimize total operations so some subset of final elements sums to the requested sum. Return -1 if impossible.
officialConstraints: Array length 1..100; each original value 1..500; target sum 1..5000.
semanticPitfalls: The multiplication-before-division restriction is per element. A subset need not include every element. Do not assume variant II has the same bounds.
title: Minimum Operations to Form Subset Sum I
